actions.label: Enable Dark Mode
actions.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Enabling Dark Mode' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize" /v "AppsUseLightTheme" /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
reg add "HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize" /v "SystemUsesLightTheme" /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

actions.label: Show File Extensions
actions.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Showing File Extensions' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v "HideFileExt" /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

actions.label: Show Hidden Files
actions.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Showing Hidden Files' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v "Hidden" /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

actions.label: Set Classic Right Click Menu
actions.description: Restores the Windows 10 context menu on Windows 11.
actions.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Setting Classic Right-Click Menu' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-34aa-4e8b-a509-50c905bae2a2}\InprocServer32" /f /ve

actions.label: Remove Home and Gallery from File Explorer
actions.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Removing Home and Gallery from File Explorer' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{f874310e-b6b7-47dc-bc84-b9e6b38f5903}" /v "System.IsPinnedToNameSpaceTree" /t REG_DWORD /d "0" /f
reg add "HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{e88865ea-0e1c-4e20-9aa6-edcd0212c87c}" /v "System.IsPinnedToNameSpaceTree" /t REG_DWORD /d "0" /f
reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v "LaunchTo" /t REG_DWORD /d "1" /f

actions.label: Move Taskbar Icons to Left
actions.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Moving Taskbar Icons to the left' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v TaskbarAl /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

actions.label: Add End Task to Context Menu
actions.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Adding End Task to Right-Click' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced\TaskbarDeveloperSettings" /v "TaskbarEndTask" /t REG_DWORD /d "1" /f

actions.label: Disable Multiplane Overlay (MPO)
actions.description: Disables MPO, might help with screen flickering and crashes.
actions.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Disabling Multiplane Overlay (MPO)' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Dwm" /v "OverlayTestMode" /t REG_DWORD /d "00000005" /f

actions.label: Disable Snap Layout
actions.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Disabling Snap Assist Flyout' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v "EnableSnapAssistFlyout" /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

actions.label: Disable Sticky Keys
actions.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Disabling Sticky Keys' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys" /v "Flags" /t REG_SZ /d "58" /f

actions.label: Disable Numlock on Startup
actions.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Disabling Num Lock on Startup' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Keyboard" /v "InitialKeyboardIndicators" /t REG_SZ /d "0" /f

actions.label: Enable Detailed BSOD
actions.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Enabling Detailed BSOD' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\CrashControl" /v "DisplayParameters" /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

actions.label: Enable Verbose Logon
actions.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Enabling Verbose Logon' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System" /v "VerboseStatus" /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
